title: Spreadsheet Studio
author: Seth Morrow
description: Real Excel files, made and read back in your browser. It opens playing four short scenes: a sheet fills itself and gets its colours, money format and chart; formulas and today's date; all fifteen kinds of chart; ten thousand cells written and read back, timed. Then try it yourself: type a table, pick fonts and colours, add formulas, dates, charts and a picture, and download the .xlsx, or open any .xlsx to look inside it.
